name: Life Return
description: Control of the body's own processes, and faster healing: masters of body control teach it to those with Willpower 60.

stages.name: Control of breath
stages.description: Slow the heart, steady the breath.
stages.text: You slowed your own heart and felt it obey.

stages.name: Control of hair and organs
stages.description: Move hair, sweat, the stomach, on purpose.
stages.text: Your hair moved because you told it to.

stages.name: Rapid healing
stages.description: Heal in a day what takes a month.
stages.text: You closed a wound by will alone.
